messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High HTTP 5xx rate for inference-gateway (eu-west1). Trigger: error_rate > 8% over 2m. Approx 1.2k/min failing. PD incident: INC-45982

emily (oncall): acked. I'm on it. paging raj for SRE help.

raj (sre): on team, joining. seeing a 502/504 mix across frontend -> auth-proxy -> inference-gateway. topology shows fast rise at 14:03 UTC.

katie (support): PSA: some customers reporting degraded API responses — intermittent 502s. Tracking any major accounts affected?

miguel (platform-eng): I'm watching autoscaler events — no recent scale failures, but a bunch of 429->retry cascades in the router logs. Could be upstream auth timeouts backing up.

raj (sre): ok quick triage:
- gateway p95 latency jumped from 120ms -> 2.1s
- error_rate by route: /v1/generate ~ 12%, /v1/chat ~ 9%
- many responses show `upstream read timeout` from auth-proxy cluster eu-west1-a

emily (oncall): following runbook: we should try routing fallback for new traffic to eu-west2 and enable model-variant fallback for critical customers. Can we flip routing policy for public tier first?

miguel (platform-eng): executing circuit-swap to fallback region for new requests. Command:
```
platformctl route swap --from eu-west1 --to eu-west2 --services inference-gateway --mode gradual --weight 0.3
```

ops-bot: exec log: initiated route swap (txn=0x7c1f) weight=0.3. Healthchecks passing for eu-west2 nodes.

raj (sre): also bumping retry budget and reducing client-side concurrency to avoid KV cache pressure. Applying temporary rate-limiter on non-logged-in routes. Patch: `gateway.conf -> max_concurrent_per_conn=8`

katie (support): notifying top-5 SKUs and named accounts (email batch queued). ETA for customer note: ~8m.

emily (oncall): attempting to hotfix auth-proxy timeouts as well — increasing upstream timeout to 10s while we investigate auth latency.

raj (sre): pulling a sample trace: many spans show `auth-proxy` waiting on `userdb` for 1.8-2.4s. Could be a DB replica lag or network flapping. Engaging platform DB team? @miguel can you confirm?

miguel (platform-eng): DB metrics show short I/O latency spike on eu-west1-read-replica-3 at 13:58 UTC. Ops ticket opened with infra: INFRA-6672. For now, routing away reduces pressure.

ops-bot: healthcheck: eu-west1 cluster degraded -> marking 22% of nodes unhealthy in load balancer.

raj (sre): mitigation checklist update:
- [x] Acked
- [x] Route fallback initiated (eu-west2 30%)
- [x] Increased upstream timeout to 10s for auth-proxy
- [x] Applied temporary rate-limit on anonymous endpoints
- [ ] Verify rollback criteria and watch for error-rate drop to <2% for 10m

emily (oncall): fwiw enabling model-variant fallback for highest SLA keys to smaller model (faster p50) to reduce per-request pressure. Doing canary to 5% of keys.

miguel (platform-eng): `platformctl model fallback --keys-file /tmp/top-slas.txt --variant light --percent 5` executed. Canary logs look clean.

katie (support): customers pushed: 3 brief escalations opened. All on ticketing, letting account reps know we're mitigating and routing.

raj (sre): monitoring graphs: overall 5xx dropped from 12% -> 6% after swap started. Need sustained drop. Keeping PD incident open and escalating to L2 if not under control in 15m.

ops-bot: PD incident INC-45982 updated: acknowledgement and mitigation actions recorded. Next escalation window: 15m.

emily (oncall): quick question — any cache warmups required after routing? KV cache is per-region; eu-west2 cache is cold which may raise latency temporarily. Tradeoff accepted.

miguel (platform-eng): yep expect initial latency bump for eu-west2 (~200ms for first few minutes) while KV warms. We'll pre-warm hot prefixes for top routes:
```
prewarmctl start --routes /v1/generate,/v1/chat --region eu-west2 --duration 10m
```
ops-bot: prewarm job started.

raj (sre): logs: sample 502 stack snippet:
```
[14:06:13] inference-gateway -> auth-proxy: read timeout after 5s
[14:06:13] auth-proxy -> userdb: query took 2.1s
[14:06:13] gateway -> client: 502 Bad Gateway
```

emily (oncall): update for PD: error rate trending down, customer impact limited to intermittent 502s for a subset of requests, active mitigations: routing fallback, increased upstream timeouts, rate-limits, model fallback. Will keep monitoring and handoff in 30m unless stable.

katie (support): posted status update to affected customers, included workaround (retry once after 1s).

raj (sre): note: if eu-west1 recovers, we should shift traffic back gradually. Rollback plan in runbook: `route swap --weight -0.3` over 10m increments.

miguel (platform-eng): infra ticket shows node I/O recovering; replication lag clearing at 14:12 UTC. Ops recommends hold for 20m to confirm stability.

ops-bot: healthcheck: eu-west1 unhealthies decreased to 4%.

emily (oncall): setting status: monitoring. Will hand off to next oncall at 14:40 UTC (in 30m). If metrics remain <2% error rate for 20m, we'll close PD.

raj (sre): +1 good work. leave runbook notes in incident doc: /incidents/INC-45982.

katie (support): thanks team — I'll follow up with the three escalations once incident closes.

ops-bot: PD incident INC-45982: last update logged 14:14 UTC.

emily (oncall): handing off to raj for the remainder of the watch window. Raj, you're primary until 15:00 UTC.

raj (sre): taking handoff. continuing to monitor. Will close once metrics stable for 20m.

ops-bot: thread closed to new reactions (automated after handoff).
